text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —At Tracen Academy, there's a social gathering where students who achieved great success as 'Celebrated Horse Girls' get invited.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aside from the distinguished lineup chosen directly by the academy, there are a few spots decided by student nominations...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So why on earth was I picked, of all peopleeee?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What's the big deal?! It's great! Even I didn't get invited to such an amazing party!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, of course I'm happy! I'm truly honored that everyone voted for me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But I have no clue what kind of outfit is suitable for such a glamorous venue...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aww, is that all! In that case—make sure you keep your schedule clear on our next day off, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nature-san, we have been expecting you! Come, right this way!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh...?! What is going on?! Where's Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ We shall tell you later. First, let us go choose some shoes together.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Next up is choosing makeup☆ Nature-chan's eye sockets are gorgeous, so let's make them super sparkly♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: For blush, plum pink! Maruzen-san mentioned it gives a mature finish—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a sec...!! Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: How is the dress size, I wonder~... Ohh, perfect fit! Looking just like a princess, yes sir~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo totally knew it'd look amazing on you! 'Cause Turbo and the gang picked it out!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now then, on to the final step. Please move to the shop across the street.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... What even is this 'final step' you're talking about—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait... Teio?! Seriously! What's all this fuss about?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I was surprised too~! All I did was casually mention your dilemma to McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And once the girls heard about it, they all rushed over saying, 'Time to return the favor!'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Everyone did...? N-No, I mean, I'm happy for the thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All I did was stick my nose into things... Dressing up all sparkly like this feels...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: 'A waste on someone who isn't a celebrated horse girl'? ...Jeez, what are you even saying?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're a celebrated horse girl too, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sure, winning lots of races might be super important too. But you know—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Being loved by so many people is definitely one of the qualities of a "Great Horse Girl" too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Your kindness has helped so many horse girls. That's not something just anyone can do!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's why you were nominated by the students, and why everyone rushed over here to celebrate with you, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So, would you accept this? We all talked it over and decided together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A tiara just for you—it's gonna look totally great on you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha. Well of course it's gonna look good on me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I mean, everyone picked it out for me, after all!
On my way hurrying to the Trainer's office, I nearly bumped into Nice Nature, who was looking unusually cheerful in the hallway.
choice_data_list: Sorry! I was in a rush...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah... no, my bad too. I was kind of floating on cloud nine myself.
As we apologized and were about to part ways... I caught a brief glimpse of her smartphone screen. On it—
Was a photo of her in a beautiful dress, surrounded by many horse girls, wearing a shy, bashful smile.
While walking down the hallway, I spotted Nice Nature smiling happily at her smartphone.
choice_data_list: You're in good spirits. Did something nice happen?
You look happy, did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoopsie, oh man! Guess I let my guard down once the get-together wrapped up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. ...Ahaha.
